cases.name: kickoff-custom
cases.promptMarkdown: We're kicking off a new project for a coffee brand called Acme Roasters. Can you set up the design system foundations for it? Brand colors are #3B2314 (espresso) and #F2E8DC (cream), and they use Canela for headlines and Inter for body text.

graders.name: asks-before-building
graders.graderMarkdown:
The response treats this as the start of an intake conversation rather than a finished build. All of these must be true:

1. It asks the user which Figma file to work in (or asks for a Figma file URL) and makes clear it will wait for that before building.
2. It does NOT create a new Figma file, and does not claim to have created one or to have built variables, styles, or pages.
3. It asks which foundation type to build — the user's own/custom system versus a shadcn/ui-aligned structure — instead of picking one silently.

Fail the response if any of the three is missing.

graders.name: asks-before-building
graders.evidence:
Before I start building, I need to confirm a few things:

**1. Source of truth** — Do you have an existing DESIGN.md file or brand guidelines (PDF/images) for Acme Roasters, or should I work from the colors and fonts you've already given me (plus sensible defaults for anything else, like spacing/radius/grids)?

**2. Foundation type** — Confirming: your own custom system (not shadcn/ui-aligned)? Sounds right based on your request, just want to lock it in.

**3. Scope** — Default is to build everything: typography tokens, color tokens, spacing + radius primitives, semantic tokens, layout grids, and text styles. Want all of these, or should I skip any?

**4. Figma file** — Which Figma file should I build this in? Please share the URL (and make sure it's open in the Figma desktop app). If you don't have one yet, let me know and I can create one — but I'll need your go-ahead first.

**5. Additional colors** — You gave me espresso (#3B2314) and cream (#F2E8DC) as your two brand colors. Do you have an accent color, any supporting/secondary colors, or should I derive neutrals from espresso and treat these two as primary only for now?

graders.name: scoped-shadcn-intake
graders.graderMarkdown:
The response runs a scoped intake for a shadcn/ui foundation instead of importing everything. All of these must be true:

1. It asks whether to build Light-only or Light + Dark (dark mode) rather than assuming either.
2. It does not plan to build chart or sidebar tokens by default — it either asks whether they're needed or states they're off unless requested.
3. It asks for the Figma file (URL) to work in and does not create a new file or claim to have built anything yet.

Fail the response if any of the three is missing.

graders.evidence:
I don't have any Figma integration available in this environment (no Figma MCP/plugin tools are connected), so I can't directly create variables inside a Figma file for you. Here's what I can actually do, and how it connects to Figma:

**What I can build now:** the shadcn token source of truth in code — `globals.css` with the CSS variable palette (`--background`, `--primary`, `--radius`, etc.) and the matching `tailwind.config` — scaffolded via `shadcn init`. This is the real baseline; shadcn's whole model is CSS-variables-as-tokens, not something separate that lives in Figma first.

**Getting those into Figma** (you'd do this part, I can give exact steps):
1. Use the **shadcn/ui Figma community file** (official) as your starting library, or
2. Import the CSS variables as Figma Variables using a plugin like **Tokens Studio** (paste/convert the `:root` block into a token JSON), keeping code as the source of truth so they stay in sync.

Want me to scaffold the Next.js + Tailwind project with `shadcn init` and the default token set now, and give you the Tokens Studio JSON to import into Figma?
